about.intro: {{name}} waa xarunta bulshada ee akhriska, waxbarashada, iyo kobcinta aqoonta ee Garbahaareey, Gedo. Hel aragtiyo cusub, wax ku baro goobo deggan, oo baar kumanaan buug.
about.builtText1: Maktabaddu waxay ka bilaabataa urur, laakiin waxay nolosha ku helaa dadka akhriya. Bogganayagu wuxuu ka dhigayaa ururintaas mid fudud in la sahamiyo wuxuuna kaa caawinayaa inaad la socoto waxa aad rabto inaad akhrido.
about.builtText2: Baadh adigoon akoon lahayn. Markaad diyaar tahay, noqo xubin si aad u kaydiso cinwaannada, u dhigato kaydin, oo aad u maamusho amaahahaaga.
about.discoverText: Ka raadi cinwaan, qoraa, ama ISBN. Sahami qaybaha oo hubi nuqulada jira.
about.personalText: Hay liis akhris oo ka daawo kaydintaada akoonkaaga xubinta.
about.connectedText: Hubi taariikhaha celinta, cusboonaysii amaahaha, oo ka qaado buugaagta shaqaalaha maktabadda.
about.newText: Baro sida kaydinta, qaadashada, cusboonaysiinta iyo celinta u shaqeeyaan.

story.title: Sheekadeena: Taariikhda iyo Horumarka Maktabadda
story.p1: Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey waxaa lagu aasaasay magaalada Garbahaareey, oo ah caasimadda taariikhiga ah ee gobolka Gedo ee Jubaland, Soomaaliya. Maktabaddu waxay ku dhalatay dadaal bulsho oo ay horseedeen macallimiin, odayaal, iyo dhalinyaro garwaaqsaday baahida loo qabo xarun waxbarasho iyo buugaag aqooneed.
story.p2: Iyadoo ka bilaabatay deeqo buugag ah iyo goobo akhris oo iskaa wax u qabso ah, maktabaddu waxay u kortay xarun gobol oo habaysan. Sanadihii la soo dhaafay, waxay ballaarisay qolalka akhriska, waxay buugagteeda gelisay nidaamka casriga ah, waxayna furtay nidaam dijitaal ah oo u adeega akhristayaasha maanta.
story.p3: Maanta, Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey waxay taagan tahay tiir muhiim u ah bulshada, iyadoo si siman u bixisa aqoon, dhowreysa suugaanta iyo taariikhda Soomaaliyeed, una adeegta jiilalka cusub ee ardayda iyo aqoonyahanka.
story.milestone1Text: Macallimiin iyo waxgarad ayaa bilaabay aruurinta buugaagta ugu horreeyay.
story.milestone2Text: Dhisidda qolalka akhriska iyo meelaha ardaydu wax ku bartaan ee jidka weyn.
story.milestone3Text: Hirgelinta buug-raadiyaha online-ka ah iyo diiwaangelinta xubnaha.
story.milestone4Title: Xarunta Gobolka ee Aqoonta iyo Hiddaha
story.milestone4Text: Tartamada akhriska dhalinyarada iyo dhowridda suugaanta Soomaaliyeed.

director.title: Farriinta Agaasimaha
director.name: Daahir Maxamed Cali
director.quote: “Waxaan si diirran ugu soo dhawaynayaa qof kasta oo jecel akhriska iyo aqoonta Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey. Aqoontu waa aasaaska sharafta qofka iyo horumarka bulshada.”
director.message: Magaca shaqaalaha iyo guddiga Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey, sharaf weyn bay ii tahay inaan idinku soo dhaweeyo maktabaddiina. Maktabaddu waa ka badan tahay khaanado buugag ah—waa wadnaha garaacaya ee bulshadeena, xarun nabdoon oo wax lagu barto, iyo albaab u furan fursadaha oo dhan. Haddii aad tahay arday u diyaar garoobaya imtixaanada, macallin cilmi-baaris samaynaya, ama akhriste doonaya aqoon cusub, shaqaalaheennu waxay diyaar u yihiin inay ku caawiyaan. Ku soo dhawaada cutubkiina xiga.

mission.title: Himiladeena
mission.statement: Inaan awoodsiino bulshadeena annagoo siinaaya fursad siman oo ay ku helaan buugaagta iyo aqoonta, dhiirrigelinta dhaqanka akhriska, iyo dhowridda hiddaha iyo suugaanta Soomaaliyeed ee Garbahaareey iyo guud ahaan gobolka Gedo.
mission.p1: Kobcinta akhriska carruurta iyo waxbarashada cimriga oo dhan.
mission.p2: Bixinta fursad siman oo bilaash ah oo lagu helo buugaagta iyo goobaha waxbarashada.
mission.p3: Dhowridda iyo horumarinta suugaanta, gabayada, iyo taariikhda Soomaaliyeed.
mission.p4: Taageerada ardayda iyo macallimiinta ee agabka cilmi-baarista.

vision.title: Aragtideena Fog
vision.statement: Inaan noqono xarunta ugu horreysa ee gobolka ee aqoonta, dhowridda dhaqanka, iyo hal-abuurka waxbarashada ee koonfur-galbeed Soomaaliya—annagoo dhiirrigelinayna bulsho aqoon leh oo isku filan.
vision.p1: Ballaarinta ururinta buugaagta ee afafka Soomaaliga, Carabiga, iyo Ingiriiska.
vision.p2: Hirgelinta goobo dijitaal ah iyo barnaamijyo waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada.
vision.p3: Fidinta adeegyada waxbarashada ee dugsiyada degmada Garbahaareey iyo nawaaxigeeda.
vision.p4: Dhisidda kayd taariikheed oo lagu kalsoonaan karo oo ku saabsan hiddaha gobolka.

contact.title: La Xiriir Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey
contact.intro: Su'aal ma ka qabtaa xubinnimada, amaahda buugaagta, qolalka akhriska, ama barnaamijyadeenna? Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan ku caawino.
contact.speakText: Shaqaalaha maktabadda waxay kaa caawin karaan qaadashada iyo celinta buugaagta, kaydinta, iyo helitaanka akoonka.
contact.unavailable: Macluumaadka xiriirka ee dadweynaha weli lama darin. Habaynta qaadashada iyo celinta kala hadal shaqaalaha maktabaddaada.

contact.quickText: Ka hel jawaabo ku saabsan xubinnimada, kaydinta, cusboonaysiinta, iyo xeerarka amaahda ee hadda jira.
contact.formIntro: Noo sheeg waxa aad caawimaad ugu baahan tahay. Fariintaada waxay heli doonaan shaqaalaha maktabadda.
contact.noSecrets: Fadlan ha ku darin erayo sir ah ama macluumaad lacag bixineed.
contact.address: Jidka Weyn (Main Street), Garbahaareey, Gedo, Soomaaliya
contact.directionsText: Waxay ku taallaa jidka weyn ee bartamaha Garbahaareey, meel u dhow xafiisyada maamulka degmada iyo suuqa weyn. Lug iyo gaadiidba waa lagu imaan karaa. Meel baabuurta iyo baaskiillada la dhigto ayaa ku taal xarunta horteeda.
contact.phoneHelp: Shaqaaluhu waxay diyaar yihiin Sabti – Khamiis: 8:00 Subaxnimo – 6:00 Galabnimo
contact.emailHelp: Su'aalaha guud waxaa lagu jawaabaa 24–48 saacadood gudahood
contact.hoursSchedule:
Sabti – Khamiis: 8:00 Subaxnimo – 6:00 Galabnimo
Jimco: Waa Xiran Tahay (Maalinta Cibaadada & Bulshada)
contact.bookDropNote: Sanduuqa buug soo celinta wuxuu furan yahay 24/7 xilliyada xafiisku xiran yahay.
contact.faqsIntro: Jawaabo degdeg ah oo ku saabsan booqashada iyo adeegyada maktabadda.
contact.faq1Q: Yaa qaadan kara kaarka maktabadda Garbahaareey?
contact.faq1A: Kaarka xubinnimadu waa bilaash wuxuuna u furan yahay dhammaan dadka deggan degmada, ardayda, macallimiinta, iyo qof kasta oo raba inuu wax akhriyo.
contact.faq2Q: Intee in le'eg ayaan buug haysan karaa, ma kordhin karaa?
contact.faq2A: Muddada caadiga ah ee buugga la haysto waa 14 maalmood. Si fudud ayaad online uga kordhin kartaa akoonkaaga ama miiska maktabadda haddii qof kale uusan qabsan buugga.
contact.faq3Q: Qolalka akhriska iyo meelaha waxbarashadu ma lacag baa?
contact.faq3A: Maya, qolalka akhriska iyo miisaska waxbarashadu waa bilaash waxayna u furan yihiin qof kasta saacadaha shaqada.
contact.faq4Q: Dugsiyada iyo kooxuhu booqasho ma soo qabanqaabin karaan?
contact.faq4A: Haa! Macallimiinta iyo ardaydu waxay nala soo xiriiri karaan iyagoo isticmaalaya foomka xiriirka ama telefoonka si booqasho gaar ah loogu habeeyo.
contact.guideBannerTitle: Ma raadinaysaa Hagaha Amaahda ama Shuruucda Maktabadda?
contact.guideBannerText: Akhriso shuruucda buug amaahashada, xaddiga buugaagta, iyo anshaxa maktabadda.

questions.question: Sidee xubin u noqdaa?
questions.answer: Fur Ku soo biir Maktabadda, buuxi foomka gaaban oo gudbi. Shaqaalaha maktabadda ayaa dib u eega codsi kasta waxaana laguu sheegi doonaa marka la ogolaado. Waxaad sidoo kale akoon isu samayn kartaa bogga Soo gal.

questions.question: Sidee buug u amaahdaa?
questions.answer: Ka hel cinwaan kaydka oo fur faahfaahintiisa. Soo gal si aad u kaydsato, kadibna la qabso shaqaalaha maktabadda qaadashada. Shaqaaluhu waxay bixiyaan nuqul gaar ah waxayna diiwaangeliyaan taariikhda celinta.

questions.question: Kaydintu ma damaanad qaadaysaa qaadasho degdeg ah?
questions.answer: Kaydintu waxay ku biirtaa safka cinwaanka. Marka nuqul banaan yahay, akhristaha ugu horreeya safka waa la ogeysiiyaa inuu diyaar yahay. Ka daawo kaydintaada albaabka xubinta.

questions.question: Waa maxay farqiga u dhexeeya kaydinta iyo kaydsiga?
questions.answer: Kaydintu waxay cinwaanka ku dartaa liiskaaga akhriska gaarka ah. Nuqul ma xirto. Kaydsigu wuxuu diiwaangeliyaa codsi amaah marka nuqul kuu diyaar yahay.

questions.question: Ma cusboonaysiin karaa amaah?
questions.answer: Fur Buugaagtayda albaabka xubinta oo dooro Cusboonaysii. Amaah lama cusboonaysiin karo haddii uu daahay, uu gaaray xadka cusboonaysiinta, ama uu leeyahay kaydin sugaysa.

questions.question: Sidee buug u celiyaa ama codsi u joojiyaa?
questions.answer: Nuqulada jidhka ah u celi shaqaalaha maktabadda si ay u diiwaangeliyaan celinta. Si aad kaydin u joojiso, fur Kaydinta albaabka xubinta oo dooro Jooji.

questions.question: Maxaa dhaca haddii buug daaho?
questions.answer: Amaahaha daahay waxay ka muuqdaan akoonkaaga. Fadlan ku celi buugaagta ama la hadal shaqaalaha maktabadda. Amaah cusub waa la xiraa inta aad leedahay amaaho daahay, ganaax ayaa dhici kara haddii maktabaddu dejisay.

questions.question: Xaggee ka arkaa cusboonaysiinta amaahahayga?
questions.answer: Fur Ogeysiisyada albaabka xubinta si aad u hesho cusboonaysiinta amaahda iyo kaydinta. Iimayl la xaqiijiyay, maktabaddu waxay kaloo diri kartaa xasuusin marka gaarsiinta iimaylka la furo.

hero.title: Maxaa ka cusub maktabadda?
hero.intro: La soco howlaha Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey, barnaamijyada akhriska, ogeysiisyada, iyo dhacdooyinka soo socda. Qof kasta wuu ka qayb qaadan karaa.

empty.upcomingTitle: Ma jiraan dhacdooyin dhowaan la qorsheeyay
empty.upcomingText: Dib u soo eeg mar dhow ama la hadal shaqaalaha maktabadda si aad wax uga ogaato barnaamijyada soo socda.
empty.pastTitle: Kaydka ma ku jiraan dhacdooyin hore
empty.pastText: Dhacdooyinka dhamaaday iyo warbixinadooda waxay ka soo muuqan doonaan halkan.

details.audienceText: U furan dhammaan ardayda, macallimiinta, iyo bulshada. Waa bilaash.

hero.title: Adeegyada Maktabadda ee Akhristayaasha & Ardayda
hero.intro: Maktabadda Dadweynaha ee Garbahaareey waxay bixisaa agab waxbarasho oo xaqiijisan, goobo deggan oo wax lagu akhriyo, iyo adeegyo casri ah si loo taageero akhriska iyo waxbarashada.

lending.title: Amaahda Buugaagta
lending.desc: Ka amaaho kumanaan buug oo isugu jira sheekooyin, saynis, taariikh, diinta Islaamka, iyo manhajka dugsiyada adigoo si fudud u cusboonaysiin kara.
features: Amaaho buugaag badan adigoo isticmaalaya kaarkaaga xubinnimada
Muddada amaahda caadiga ah waa 14 maalmood oo la kordhin karo
Ururin buugaag ah oo ku qoran afafka Soomaaliga, Carabiga, iyo Ingiriiska

catalog.title: Kaydka Buugaagta ee Online-ka ah
catalog.desc: Ka raadi dhammaan buugaagta maktabadda 24/7. Hubi haddii buuggu yaallo, eeg sharraxaadda, oo ka qabso taleefankaaga ama kombiyuutarkaaga.
features: Raadin degdeg ah oo cinwaan, qoraa, iyo qayb ah
Ogaanshaha tooska ah ee khaanada uu buuggu yaallo
Ka shaqaynaya moobaylka, tablet-ka, iyo kombiyuutarka

facilities.title: Goobaha Akhriska iyo Waxbarashada
facilities.desc: Meelo deggan, hawo wanaagsan leh, iftiin fiicanna leh oo loogu talagalay wax akhris gaar ah, diyaarinta imtixaannada, iyo daraasaadka.
features: Kuraas gaar ah oo wax lagu akhriyo iyo miisas wadajir ah
Qol gaar ah oo loogu talagalay akhriska carruurta
Deegaan nadiif ah, ammaan ah, oo la isku xurmeeyo

research.title: Caawinta Cilmi-baarista iyo Macluumaadka
research.desc: Hel caawinaad toos ah oo ka timaada shaqaalaheenna xirfadda leh si aad u hesho agabka waxbarashada, u xaqiijiso xogta, oo aad u hesho buugaag naadir ah.
features: Caawin gaar ah oo ka socota miiska macluumaadka
Taageerada ardayda dugsiyada sare ee u diyaar garoobaya imtixaanka
Hagidda taariikhda iyo suugaanta gobolka Gedo

reservations.title: Qabashada Buugaagta (Reservations)
reservations.desc: Ha seegin buug aad xiisaynayso. Online ka qabso buugaagta la amaahday, waxaana lagu soo wargelinayaa isla markii la soo celiyo.
features: Hal gujis ku qabso buug adigoo isticmaalaya akoonkaaga
Farriin degdeg ah marka buuggu diyaar kuu noqdo
Fursad 48 saacadood ah oo aad ku soo doonaneyso buugga

programs.title: Barnaamijyada Waxbarashada iyo Dhacdooyinka
programs.desc: Ka qayb qaado tababarrada akhriska, tartamada dhalinyarada, doodaha qorayaasha, iyo habeenada dhaqanka ee la qabto sanadka oo dhan.
features: Duruusta kooxeed ee ardayda dugsiyada sare

process.title: Sida loo Isticmaalo Adeegyadeena
process.lead: Saddex tallaabo oo fudud oo aad ku heli karto dhammaan adeegyada Maktabadda Garbahaareey.
process.step1Text: Iska diiwaangeli online ama imow miiska maktabadda ee jidka weyn si aad u qaadato kaarkaaga rasmiga ah.
process.step2Text: Isticmaal kaydka online-ka ah ama dhex gal khaanadaha si aad u hesho buugga aad u baahan tahay.
process.step3Text: Buugaagta guriga u qaado, wax ku baro qolalka deggan, ama ka qayb qaado barnaamijyada bulshada.

cta.title: Diyaar ma u tahay inaad ka faa'iidaysato maktabadda?
cta.text: Xubinnimadu waa bilaash waxayna u furan tahay dhammaan dadka deggan Garbahaareey, ardayda, iyo macallimiinta.
